#include "GridPathSolver.h"
#include "KnapsackPlanner.h"
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
bool containsIndex(const std::vector<int>& values, int target) { for (int value : values) { if (value == target) { return true; } } return false; }
void printPath(const std::vector<std::pair<int, int>>& path) { for (const auto& point : path) { std::cout << "(" << point.first << "," << point.second << ")"; } std::cout << "\n"; }
int main() { std::vector<std::vector<int>> grid = { {5, 1, 4}, {2, 7, 1}, {3, 2, 9} }; int maxReward = 0; std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> path; bool gridOk = GridPathSolver_solve(grid, maxReward, path); std::vector<std::vector<int>> emptyGrid; int emptyReward = 99; std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> emptyPath; bool emptyOk = GridPathSolver_solve(emptyGrid, emptyReward, emptyPath); std::vector<int> weights = { 3, 4, 7, 8, 9 }; std::vector<int> values = { 4, 5, 10, 11, 13 }; int bestValue = 0; std::vector<int> selected; bool packOk = KnapsackPlanner_plan(weights, values, 17, bestValue, selected); std::vector<int> invalidValues = { 1 }; int invalidValue = 0; std::vector<int> invalidSelected; bool invalidOk = KnapsackPlanner_plan(weights, invalidValues, -1, invalidValue, invalidSelected); bool pathOk = path.size() == 5 && path.front() == std::make_pair(0, 0) && path.back() == std::make_pair(2, 2); bool selectedOk = selected.size() == 2 && containsIndex(selected, 3) && containsIndex(selected, 4); if (!gridOk || maxReward != 25 || !pathOk || emptyOk || !packOk || bestValue != 24 || !selectedOk || invalidOk) { std::cout << "projectdd DP demo failed\n"; std::cout << "Grid max reward: " << maxReward << "\n"; std::cout << "Knapsack max value: " << bestValue << "\n"; return 1; } std::cout << "Grid max reward: " << maxReward << "\n"; std::cout << "Grid path: "; printPath(path); std::cout << "Knapsack max value: " << bestValue << "\n"; std::cout << "Selected item indices:"; for (int index : selected) { std::cout << " " << index; } std::cout << "\n"; std::cout << "projectdd DP demo completed successfully\n"; return 0; }
